description: 5 x 5 mm low-capacitance silicon photodiode chip for alpha-particle detection (radon)
source_url: https://www.excelitas.com/product/vth2110-silicon-photodiode-chip-form (page blocks scripted download, HTTP 403; PDF copy obtained from the JLCPCB part page for C20278360)
doc_revision: VTH21xx series Rev 2022.06 (page footer says 'Page x of 6' but PDF has 5 pages)

pins.note: No anode/cathode marking in the datasheet. Drawing (p2, Fig 1) shows active area 5.000 mm square with a bond pad (0.4 mm wide) on the top face at the bottom edge. Chip is die-attached with conductive epoxy (back contact).

application_notes: Key parameters are specified at 20 V and 40 V reverse bias; no recommended operating bias is given (p1). Breakdown > 100 V at 100 uA.
Capacitance falls from about 32 pF at 20 V to about 12 pF at 200 V (Fig 3), so higher bias lowers preamp noise but raises dark current.
Table says CJ < 30 pF at 20 V, while the typical curve reads about 32 pF at 20 V. Use 30 pF as the spec and about 33 pF as a conservative design value until measured.
gotchas: Anode/cathode and which face is which are not stated: measure with a DMM diode test on a spare chip before layout.
Bond pad is only 0.4 mm wide: needs wire bonding or conductive epoxy; plain ENIG may not be suitable for ultrasonic wire bonding (VERIFY).
Chip is 5.67 mm square: four chips in a 2x2 array have a diagonal of at least 16.0 mm, which does not fit a 16 mm ID tube.
not_extracted: Series resistance and shunt resistance (not given)
